races.name: Fructan
races.description: Colourful, flavourful fruit-born folk; charismatic and adventurous.

races.name: Vegfolk
races.description: Grounded and practical vegetable folk of the Root Realms and Leafy Canopies.

races.name: Fungifolk
races.description: Earthy, enigmatic folk bound to the mycelial networks of the Marketrealm.

races.name: Rootkin
races.description: Ancient root-folk tied to deep soil, patience and vegetable memory.

races.name: Dairyfolk
races.description: Cultured folk born of cheeses, creams and milk products.

races.name: Frostreem
races.description: Frozen dairyfolk descended from enchanted custards, gelatos and ice creams.

races.name: Sizzlarian / Meatfolk
races.description: Meat-born folk whose Emberwalk reveals their adult path and True Flame Name.

races.name: Herbanite / Herbfolk
races.description: Fragrant plantfolk born of aromatic roots and leaves.

races.name: The Recalled
races.description: Removed, discontinued or spoiled foodstuffs returned with strange memories and patchwork forms.

races.name: Boxfolk
races.description: Awakened preserved, canned and frozen goods with durable shells and perfect memories.

races.name: Sweetfolk
races.description: Confection-born folk united by sugarblood and distracting sweetness.

races.name: Marshmallow Folk
races.description: Puffy folk of the Cereal Steppes, sweet, buoyant and unexpectedly flame-touched.

races.name: Fluffling
races.description: Airy beings woven from enchanted sugar threads, cheerful and difficult to pin down.

races.name: Drinkling
races.description: Fluid folk bound to flow, refreshment and change.

heritages.name: Carrotfolk — The Keenroots
heritages.description: Carrotfolk — The Keenroots.

features.name: Keen Eyes
features.description: You have darkvision out to 60 feet and are proficient in Perception.

features.name: Spring from the Soil
features.description: When initiative is rolled, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

heritages.name: Potatofolk — The Stoutroots
heritages.description: Potatofolk — The Stoutroots.

features.name: Stout Growth
features.description: Your maximum hit points increase by 1 for each character level.

features.name: Firmly Planted
features.description: Your rooted build helps you resist effects that would forcibly move you or knock you prone.

features.name: Watchful Tuber
features.description: You gain the Potatofolk perception-related proficiency benefit described in the Players Handbook, including its listed Insight or Survival fallback.

features.name: Potato Resilience
features.description: Once per long rest, when you would be reduced to 0 hit points, you can remain at 1 hit point instead.

heritages.name: Onionfolk — The Many-Layered
heritages.description: Onionfolk — The Many-Layered.

features.name: Layered Defence
features.description: Your many protective layers grant the defensive benefit described for Onionfolk in the Players Handbook.

features.name: Eye-Watering Defence
features.description: Your pungent defensive reaction follows the Eye-Watering Defence rule described in the Players Handbook.

features.name: Peel Away
features.description: You have advantage on checks or saves used to resist or escape being grappled or restrained.

heritages.name: Garlicfolk — The Pungent
heritages.description: Garlicfolk — The Pungent.

features.name: Repellent Aroma
features.description: Your aroma provides the protective effect described for Garlicfolk in the Players Handbook.

features.name: Graveward
features.description: You gain the Garlicfolk protection against undead fear and know the spare the dying cantrip, using Wisdom or Charisma as described in the Players Handbook.

heritages.name: Parsnipfolk — The Deeproots
heritages.description: Parsnipfolk — The Deeproots.

features.name: Deep Lore
features.description: Choose proficiency in Nature or History.

features.name: Root Magic
features.description: You know druidcraft and later gain the speak with animals and speak with plants magic described for Parsnipfolk in the Players Handbook.

features.name: Rooted Meditation
features.description: You gain the Rooted Meditation benefit described for Parsnipfolk in the Players Handbook.

subclasses.name: Oath of Aroma
subclasses.description: A Paladin oath devoted to presence, perception and the invisible influence carried through the Marketrealm.

subclasses.name: Aislewarden Conclave
subclasses.description: Classic Marketrealm scouts, trackers, monster hunters and protectors of the roads between kingdoms. Core identity: tracking, ambushing and mobility.

subclasses.name: Deep-Root Warden
subclasses.description: Protectors of the Rootlands who fight alongside the living earth. Core identity: battlefield control and durability.

subclasses.name: Cold Vault Stalker
subclasses.description: Rangers who patrol the Cold Vaults and frozen wilderness where even other Frostreem fear to travel. Core identity: cold damage, survival and slowing enemies.

subclasses.name: Conclave of the Forager
subclasses.description: Herbfolk Foragers are healers, poisoners, trackers and survival experts who carry entire apothecaries in their packs. Core identity: herbal concoctions and party support.

subclasses.name: Spice Trail Hunter
subclasses.description: Sizzlarian trackers carrying enchanted spice mixtures that modify ammunition and weapons. Core identity: elemental ammunition.

subclasses.name: Rindrunner
subclasses.description: Rangers who patrol cheese caves, Dairy Dominion borders and the labyrinth beneath the Cheddar Cliffs. Core identity: defensive ranged combat and monster hunting.

subclasses.name: Seedshot Conclave
subclasses.description: Melonian sharpshooters who grow enchanted seed ammunition that erupts into magical plants on impact. Core identity: trick arrows—but they are seeds.

subclasses.name: Expiry Hunter
subclasses.description: Recalled hunters of Rotlings, Spoiled Shamblers, Molders, Necrobeef and other creatures of decay. Core identity: anti-undead and anti-corruption monster hunting.
